rationale.reason: A complete locally stored downloadable video file matches; streaming, original production and broadcasting remain excluded.

reviewed_boundary.scope:
1. Scope and Applicability

This PCR covers films and other recorded video delivered as electronic files that can be downloaded and stored locally. It covers complete movies, episodes and other bounded recordings, without a default genre, duration, codec, resolution, file size or commercial model. Purchase, rental and subscription downloads qualify only when the actual local-copy and permitted-use conditions are defined. Streams, live broadcast, audio-only downloads, software, physical video media, original creation and bare network-access services are separate outputs. [un-cpc3-video; apple-video-download]

The material method need is rendition-specific shared preparation/storage attribution, complete local-delivery acceptance and separation of original-creation reuse from repeated transfers. Original production is an upstream layer with an explicit reuse share, not repeated foreground filming for each download. Video quality and soundtrack/subtitle completeness define comparable products; one byte, user, licence or sale is not the functional unit.
reviewed_boundary.covered: Complete locally stored downloadable film/video recordings with declared rendition and access conditions
reviewed_boundary.excluded: Streaming; broadcast/channel originals; original film-making; audio/software downloads; physical media; generic telecom services
reviewed_boundary.market_state: One accepted electronic video download with declared rights, expiry and compatibility; neither transfer of the original IP asset nor perpetual ownership is presumed

evidence_limitations: Official CPC notes distinguish downloadable locally stored recordings from streams; they do not define an LCA factor or universal quality.
Apple documentation is a real provider-specific route example; its device and expiry restrictions are not universal download rules.
SCI 1.1.0 supports computing energy and hardware attribution only; this PCR does not claim an SCI-conformant full score.
Actual original production and cross-channel reuse, rendition work, storage, network, receiving device and supplier inventories are required; unknowns cannot be zeroed.
No actual factory/provider measurements are supplied; no default energy per byte, file size, lifetime, loss, download count, regional data centre or direct emission is prescribed.
unresolved_range_evidence: Collect actual complete delivery, original/rendition reuse pools, metered power, provider technical jobs and reserved device time/resources; no universal numerical range is supported.
